messages.costBody: Answering within about a minute of their message is free. After that the same reply goes out as a push message and counts against the monthly allowance.

messages.notLinkedBody: This is a LINE contact, not a parent record. LINE identifies people only by a user ID issued per channel, so there is nothing to match a family on.
messages.reasonQuota: The monthly message allowance is used up.

settings.title: Credit Rules
settings.sub: These thresholds drive the dashboard's Needs Follow-up card.

results.qrLabel: QR code linking to the public results page for this tournament

lichessAdmin.title: Lichess at home
lichessAdmin.emptyTitle: No students have connected Lichess yet
lichessAdmin.emptyBody: A student connects their own account from their profile and proves it with a code in their Lichess bio. You can also add a username for them, which stays marked unverified until they confirm it.
lichessAdmin.footnote: A ? marks a provisional rating — too few games for the number to mean much yet.

external.title: External tournaments (chess-results.com)
external.intro: Follow a tournament our students play in elsewhere. Paste the chess-results.com link and the standings are pulled in as rounds land — our students are highlighted. chess-results.com cannot be written to; this reads what the arbiter publishes.
external.previewSub: first rows of {count} players — the full table is on the public page
external.refreshSoon: Just fetched — try again in a minute.
external.refreshFailed: Could not update from chess-results.com just now.
external.linkIntro: Paste the chess-results.com address for this event. The public page then shows the arbiter's standings and round pairings, and follows their uploads while the event runs.
external.linkedIntro: This tournament follows chess-results.com. The arbiter's table is what the public page shows.
external.linkFailed: That link could not be used. Check it is a chess-results.com tournament address.
external.linkedRounds: {count, plural, =1 {1 round mirrored} other {# rounds mirrored}}
external.linkedOverridesNote: While this is linked, the public page shows the arbiter's standings and round pairings, and follows their uploads by itself while the event runs.
